messages:
maria-support: FYI customer (acme-inc) reporting a sharp p99/p95 regressions after we pushed a quant profile swap ~03:08 UTC. p99 went from ~220ms -> ~1.8s, p95 ~300ms -> ~950ms. Also seeing intermittent 401s for the same org and a billing spike. Ticket #12345.

devin-runtime: ack. saw the deploy event: `deploy quant-profile int8_fp8_mix v3 -> v4` at 03:07:42. Will pull logs. @liam-ml can int8+fp8 mix cause KV cache misses or longer decode loops?

liam-ml: possible. mech hypothesis: the calibrated scales caused larger token instability leading to extra generation steps (loopbacks). Also quant switching can change kernel selection causing tail latency. Need kvcache hit rates and model variant fallback counts.

alyssa-sre: grabbing infra metrics. p99 spike aligns with node pool pod churn at 03:09 (autoscaler enacted). There are 502 backend retries in the window. Could be correlated with the quant rollout pushing heavier per-token CPU on host.

maria-support: customer also pasted a sample curl that failed with 401s intermittently. They say keys were valid and only impacted after ~03:08.

maria-support: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-xxxx" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/generate``` -> 200 sometimes, 401 other times.``` 

devin-runtime: @deploy-bot can you confirm any auth config pushes around that time?

deploy-bot: No auth config changes at 03:00-03:15. IAM service saw a transient error cluster at 03:08:49 with increased latency, but no config rollbacks.

alyssa-sre: I've attached quick summary: node-restarts 4, avg CPU on runtime hosts up 35%, batch sizes jumped because batching window increased due to slower kernels. kvcache hit-rate dropped 12% at spike.

liam-ml: action: revert quant profile for a canary subset. Steps to reproduce locally: use `REDWOOD_PROFILE=release-int8fp8-v4 MODEL=redwood-1.2 ./run_client.sh --seq 2048` and compare with `release-fp16`.

maria-support: shared repro instructions with customer and asked for logs and exact request ids. Also offered to switch their tenant to fallback fp16 if they want immediate mitigation.

devin-runtime: rolled canary rollback for 10% of traffic at 03:22 to fp16 fallback for the affected model. Observed p99 improve to ~300-400ms within 6 minutes. Canary looked good, planning full rollback.

liam-ml: follow-ups: investigate calibration dataset coverage — some edge-case token sequences caused extra generate loops after quantization. We'll run synthetic tests with long prefix sequences and enable more conservative matmul kernels for int8 path.

alyssa-sre: mitigation checklist: 1) full rollback to fp16 (pending), 2) throttle autoscaler trigger thresholds for 15m to avoid churn, 3) temporary routing rule to prefer lower-batch latency lanes for acme-inc. I'll open infra ticket.

maria-support: customer accepted fp16 fallback and wants postmortem + estimation of billing impact (they saw a billing surge). Noted.

devin-runtime: creating incident record and will include timeline, logs, kvcache stats, and quant calibration diffs. Tagging @liam-ml for follow-up calibrations and @alyssa-sre for infra mitigations. :thumbsup:
